ownChange.observation: Not blind: several separated band-0 groups at 5500 collapse to a single small lower-left cluster at 6000. This is visible occupied-body change, but not a qualifying seasonal growth-and-retreat pattern.

seasonalChanges.observation: Not blind: the majority band 1 is empty at both 4500 and 5000. Band 0 loses its dense upper and lower masses and is reduced to two smaller middle-left groups. There is no majority expansion, so this interval fails.

Not blind: band 0 changes from two middle groups at 5000 to several separated upper, middle and lower structures at 5500. Although the majority band gains tiles, band 1 remains empty and cannot supply the required minority retreat. This interval fails.
Not blind: the upper and middle band-0 structures at 5500 disappear, leaving a small lower-left group at 6000. Majority band 1 stays empty, so this interval fails.
